summary: Client Portal (Phase 2) testing complete. Fixed critical bug in AuthContext where login function signature didn't support client token-based login. All backend endpoints pass (17/17 tests). Frontend login, registration, dashboard, and results pages all working correctly after fix.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - AuthContext login function had signature (email, password) but client-login.tsx was calling login(token, user). Modified login function to detect and handle both cases.

critical_code_review_comments: The login function in AuthContext now supports both admin login (email/password) and client login (token/user object). The detection is based on whether the second parameter is an object with 'id' and 'role' properties.
seed_data_creation: Created test client via API: phone 8091112222, password test123456
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client portal Phase 2 is fully functional. Login, registration, dashboard, results pages all work. The AuthContext was modified to support both admin (email/password) and client (token/user) login methods. Test user: 8091112222 / test123456

POST /api/clients/register.notes: Registers new client with phone, name, password. Returns token for auto-login.

POST /api/clients/login.notes: Login with phone and password via query params. Returns token and user.

GET /api/clients/me.notes: Returns client profile with recent_tickets and pending_payments.

GET /api/clients/payment-accounts.notes: Returns zelle_accounts, bank_accounts, and all_accounts arrays.

GET /api/clients/tickets.notes: Returns paginated tickets for authenticated client.

GET /api/clients/results.notes: Returns lottery results for today or specified date.

Frontend: /client-login.notes: Login form with phone/password, redirects to dashboard on success.

Frontend: /client-register.notes: Registration form with name, phone, email(optional), password fields.

Frontend: /client-dashboard.notes: Shows stats (Jugadas, Ganado), quick actions (Jugar, Mis Jugadas, Resultados, Mi Perfil).

Frontend: /client-results.notes: Shows today's date with HOY badge, empty state or lottery results.

Full login flow.notes: Login -> Dashboard -> Results navigation works correctly.

bug_fixed.description: AuthContext login function didn't support client token-based authentication
bug_fixed.root_cause: The login function signature was (email: string, password: string) but client-login.tsx was calling login(data.token, data.user) expecting direct token storage
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Modified login function to detect if second parameter is an object with 'id' and 'role' properties. If so, treats first param as token and second as user object for direct storage.
